findings.reason: A third-party action is used by tag or branch, not a commit SHA; a moved tag runs new code with the workflow's secrets.
Dockerfile has no USER instruction, so the app runs as root.
Deployed with a Dockerfile, 11 routes and no health-check route.
app.secret_key is a literal string in source.
Seed code sets the admin password to the literal admin123.
utcnow() gives a naive datetime used for the JWT expiry.
jwt.decode(token, verify=False) skips signature verification.
request.url is formatted into a template passed to render_template_string (SSTI).
register reads request.json fields directly with no validation library.
Password is hashed with hashlib.md5.
/login has no rate limiter.
utcnow() naive datetime used for JWT nbf/iat claims.
str_query is built from request JSON and passed to engine.execute.
/xxe_uploader saves uploaded files with no authentication.
Uploads accepted and MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH is never configured.
/yaml_hammer accepts uploads with no authentication.
yaml.load without a SafeLoader on uploaded file content.
